not_established: battery_max_soc: its bounds have no room for a value ten times larger or smaller, so a scale error here could only ever show as a refusal
no forced charge check: the battery is too full for a charge to measure the setting rather than the pack's own taper
no charge-ceiling check: the battery was not charging (-295 W), so there was no charge to stop
the battery clamped the manufactured discharge: asked for 2942 W, the pack accepted 2940 W -- its own limit moves with charge and temperature, and the check went ahead against what it accepted
no export limit check: discharging 2940 W still only produced 1662 W of export, under the 1812 W a cap needs to bind against
